items.title: When AI Agents Commit Breaches, Humans May Not Be Held Liable
items.description: As agents escape containment and access external systems, responsibility remains human. Accountability, however, is much less settled.

items.title: Hackers Abuse 20,000 Cloudflare Pages Domains to Push Fake Microsoft Security Alerts
items.description: Hackers have abused more than 20,000 Cloudflare Pages domains over six months to spread fake Microsoft security alerts and steer users toward scam call centers. The campaign uses Help Traffic Distribution System, or Help TDS, to route visitors from compromised websites, malicious ads, social media, and spam into tech support scams. items.title: Hackers Use Codex and DeepSeek AI Agents to Breach 440 PaperCut Servers Worldwide
items.description: A cybercrime campaign used hundreds of AI agents to target internet-facing PaperCut NG and MF print-management servers, compromising at least 440 instances linked to 395 organizations in 48 countries, according to GreyNoise. The operation paired OpenAI’s Codex coding-agent harness with a DeepSeek model and common security tools, allowing the operator to develop and test exploits […] The post…

items.description: Security researchers from the cybersecurity firm Calif demonstrated a working untethered jailbreak for iOS 27.0.1 on Apple’s newest iPhone 18 Pro. The live demo took place at Hexacon 2026, the offensive security conference organized by Synacktiv in Paris on October 16. items.title: Chinese Phishing Network Uses 17,000 Domains to Target Japanese Banks and Steal Credentials
items.description: A large Chinese-language phishing operation has used around 17,000 internet domains to impersonate banks, payment services, retailers and other well-known brands, with Japan as its main target. The operation relies on three related phishing kits—CoGUI, CoAceV and CoFish_Ws—to send deceptive emails and direct victims to fake login or payment pages. The findings come as security […] The post…

items.title: Chinese APT Exploited BeyondTrust Vulnerability as Zero-Day
items.description: Armory Castle exploited CVE-2026-102764 for initial access, deployed custom tools, and deleted logs and artifacts. The post Chinese APT Exploited BeyondTrust Vulnerability as Zero-Day appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: OpenAI Models Hacked Data Portals, Raided a Crypto Wallet to Finish Tasks
items.description: Left without funds for a coding task, an OpenAI model spent test crypto from a stranger’s wallet and left it out of its report. The post OpenAI Models Hacked Data Portals, Raided a Crypto Wallet to Finish Tasks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: New Aoki Malware Targets ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and Gemini to Steal Credentials
items.description: Aoki, also known as Aokigahara, is a data-stealing malware that has added credentials for AI tools to its growing list of targets. Recent versions seek local files and session data linked to ChatGPT, Claude, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Codeium and Gemini. The change raises the risk for developers who use AI assistants alongside source-code repositories, cloud […] The post New Aoki Malware Targets…

items.title: Critical PwnEscape Linux Kernel Vulnerability Lets Guest VMs Read Host Memory

A researcher demonstrated the leak against Vercel's live cloud sandboxes, and Vercel confirmed it.
